268: Klein circled the outside of the cemetery a few times until the night truly set in, only then did he jump over its fence. quote: At that moment, he suddenly heard footsteps coming from the outside and saw a faint light seeping in. The elderly janitor had been attracted by the banging sound in the morgue. He was approaching with a lantern in hand!

quote: “Sir, I’m only responsible for your protection, and that’s against the law.” Klein smiled in response.

271: (If there’s one thing in this world that Klein loves, it’s money)

282: Afraid of the murderer pursuing him, Klein spent the night at his rented apartment in East Borough and only left in the morning.

quote: While walking, he saw a man in his forties or fifties ahead of him. He wore a thick jacket and had gray hair around his temples. He was pacing in place and fumbling for a cigarette while shivering. Finally, he took out a box of empty matches in his clothes’ inner pocket.

He’s a homeless person who has been chased away. Klein casually asked, “Why doesn’t the king and ministers allow all of you to sleep in the park?”
